Now let me look at the fuzz target `fuzz_init_path` to understand how the input is processed:

<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul -name "fuzz_init_path*" -o -name "*fuzz*init*" | head && echo "---" && find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.c" -path "*fuzz*" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
